overview: EZmailout.com — direct mail campaigns without minimums. A $9/month membership unlocks wholesale EZmailout print rates (postcards from $1.15), an AI design studio with a pay-as-you-go credit ledger, saved audience presets, dynamic QR tracking and referral rewards, all on a single Motoko canister.
features: Full EZmailout catalog — 14 product families, 29 document classes (postcards, letters, Certified Mail, EDDM®, Priority Mail, flyers, secure mailers, notecards, rack cards, brochures, reply mail, booklets, card stock) — priced from the operator's cost/retail matrix with per-row margin reporting
Dual-path audience targeting: interactive Leaflet radius map with EDDM-style estimates, CSV upload with EZmailout CASS verification, and saved audience presets (re-run, prune, save as new)
Side-by-side design studio: 2D drag-and-drop editor with bleed/cut/safe overlays and a synchronized 3D front/back preview
AI Studio: DALL·E 3 backgrounds with industry quick-prompts and a GPT-4o mini copywriter, paid with credits (Stripe top-up packs, 50 free credits per member month)
Dynamic QR & link creator with per-recipient tracking redirects (ezmailout.com/t/{recipientId}) and scan analytics
Stripe Elements checkout for campaign orders, credit packs and the $9/month membership; referral program granting one free month per referred first payment
EZmailout print fulfilment: 300 DPI PDF upload, address list intake, job dispatch with print options, IMb tracking sync and authenticated delivery webhook
Campaign portal with a 5-stage USPS timeline, CSV export, production status and admin key management
